contracts.declarative.ResourceMetadata.description:
Common metadata for all declarative resources.

# Fields

- `name`: Resource local identifier (resolver input for identity mapping)
- `description`: Human-readable description
- `tags`: Key-value pairs for filtering and organization
- `annotations`: Key-value pairs for extended metadata (not used for filtering)
- `providerRef`: The Provider the resource is filed under

name.description:
Resource name.

This is a service-scoped local identifier used by declarative identity mapping.
The final TRN resource path is resolver-derived and may compose additional
namespace context. Workspace filename matching, if required, is a loader/workspace
policy and not a contracts-level invariant.

tags.description:
Tags for filtering and organization.

Tags are key-value pairs that can be used for:
- Filtering resources in queries
- Organizing resources by environment, team, etc.

annotations.description:
Annotations for extended metadata.

Unlike tags, annotations are not used for filtering.
They're meant for storing additional metadata like:
- Creation tool information
- External system references
- Custom metadata

providerRef.description:
The Provider this resource is filed under, as a ProviderHub Provider
TRN of the resource's own tenant.

It only files the resource for filtering and display; it never
changes how the resource runs. A Provider resource carries none.

contracts.declarative.ResourceTrn.description:
A validated literal TRN reference — the final scalar value of every
declarative reference field.

serviceAccountRef.description:
Runtime identity used to resolve model credentials and execute turns.

Model material reads and tool calls use this identity. Permissions
attach to the ServiceAccount through Auth policies, not here.

contextCompaction.description: Automatic context management, frozen with this Turn's runtime manifest.

workspace.description: Whether creating a Thread must provide a workspace root.

skillRefs.description:
The Skills the Profile may load, by TRN and in order: a stable TRN
follows the Skill's current version, a `v<n>` TRN pins one version.

tools.description: The operations the model may call.

toolTimeoutMs.description:
Time limit in milliseconds for executing one tool call. It bounds the
execution only: a wait for an approval before the call runs is not
counted and ends only by a decision or by cancelling the Turn. Must be
at least 1; when unset, the called operation's own time limit applies.

toolChoice.description:
How the language model may choose tools in Turns using this Profile.
`none` and `auto` hold for every model call of the Turn. `required`
and `{ tool }` hold for the first model call only; the calls after
tool results use `auto`, so the model can answer instead of being
forced into another tool call. `{ tool }` must name a built-in runtime
tool or a tool this Profile lists in `tools`.
When unset, every call uses `auto`.

maxSteps.description:
Maximum number of steps in one Turn. A step is one language-model call
together with the tool calls that response requested. When this many
steps have completed and the Turn would need another model call, the
Turn fails with `MaxStepsExceeded`. The count covers the whole Turn,
including segments resumed after an approval or user-input wait.
Must be at least 1; when unset, the platform default of 64 applies.

contracts.agent.AgentLanguageModelSpec.description: Optional settings for one model call. Absence preserves the adapter/provider default.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per model call, including reasoning where applicable.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Only available for supported models and modes.

limits.description:
Capacity declared by the operator for this exact custom deployment.
It is not inferred from an integrated model with the same name.

inputModalities.description: Inputs the deployment accepts; text only unless the operator says more.

contracts.core.LanguageModelLimits.description:
Applicable token constraints. Independent input/output providers need not
declare a shared window; at least one input constraint must be known.

contracts.declarative.MaterialRefs.description:
Local names mapped to literal CredVault references. A single reference
may supply several fields; different names may select the same resource.

contracts.core.HttpParameterBindings.description:
Structured Header/Query values before protocol conversion. Consumers may
evaluate templates first; only `prepare` produces transport parameters.

contracts.agent.ContextCompactionPolicy.description: Automatic history summarization; overrides are frozen at Turn admission.

triggerTokens.description: Attempts compaction above this threshold; only the safe input budget limits invocation.

keepRecentTokens.description: Recent original history budget, preserved as complete message groups.

summaryMaxOutputTokens.description: Summary call output cap, including reasoning where the model counts it.

instructions.description: Additional summary requirements, appended to the platform instructions.

contracts.declarative.AgentToolSpec.description:
One original operation a Profile exposes to its model, with the approval
the Agent asks for before running it.

connectionRef.description:
The connection the call goes through, exactly when the operation's
call binding declares one. A connection is current state: its TRN
never carries a version qualifier.

requiresApproval.description: Whether this tool requires explicit approval before execution.

contracts.core.OperationId.description: Typed operation identifier (`namespace.subject.action`) validated at construction.
